FROST_FANG.title: Ambusher
FROST_FANG.description: At the start of each combat, you may add a card from your hand to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold]. (Base capacity 3) You can switch to [gold]Ambush form[/gold].
FROST_FANG.flavor: “Lurk in the dark, and wait for the moment.”
FROST_FANG.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card from your hand to add to your Ambush zone.
ASSASSIN.title: Assassin
ASSASSIN.description: At the start of your turn, you may add a card from your hand to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold]. (Base capacity 4) You can switch to [gold]Ambush form[/gold].
LINGDAWNPAO_SURVIVAL.title: Nature's Blessing
LINGDAWNPAO_SURVIVAL.description: The first time each turn you manually add a card to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] or apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to an enemy, gain 3 [gold]Block[/gold].
LINGDAWNPAO_SURVIVAL.flavor: Survival in the snowfield is instinctive.
ASSASSIN.flavor: You have already mastered the tricks of the hunt.
ASSASSIN.selectionScreenPrompt: Select a card to add into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
COZY_PELT.title: Cozy Pelt
COZY_PELT.description: At the start of each combat, gain 6 [gold]Block[/gold].
COZY_PELT.flavor: "The whole winter hides inside the fur."
FROSTBELL.title: Frostbell
FROSTBELL.description: The first time you apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold] each turn, draw 1 card.
FROSTBELL.flavor: "The bell sweeps across the snowfield; no prey escapes it."
SNOWBALL_POUCH.title: Snowball Pouch
CAT_SNACK.title: Cat Snack
CAT_SNACK.description: The first time you add a card into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] each combat, draw 1 card.
THICKET.title: Thicket
THICKET.description: Attack cards brought out from your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] deal 2 additional damage.
THICKET.flavor: "There is more than wind hiding in the grass."
